meta.disclaimer: Platform positions are summarized from official party platforms and public statements. Always consult primary sources.

positions.title: No Platform Published
positions.summary: No platform has been published.

parties.name: BeYahad (Together)
parties.topline:
Implement a "New Agreement" that fully changes the book on how the government is run, and how it works for the benefit of Israel's citizens and Israel's standing.
To build a functioning government that works for its citizens, we need to completely overhaul it.

positions.title: Bringing the Beduins into Israeli society
positions.summary: Build the connection between the Bedouin community and the state, with economic stimulus, education, and sanctions.

positions.title: Jews around the world
positions.summary: Recognize that Israel's political position directly impacts the diaspora.

positions.title: Meeting the IDF Manpower Needs
positions.summary: Recruit 20,000 additional combat soldiers.

positions.title: Fighting the cost of living
positions.summary:
Lower the cost of food by 30% within a year, by dismantling closed industries and opening Israel to foreign suppliers.
Adopt European food standards. Unite all food import bureaucracy under one authority. Prohibit monopolies from managing more than one food sector.
Prohibit contracts between suppliers and grocery stores/chains that made it harder for small importers to break into the market.
Abolish tariffs and instead subsidize farmers who are identified as being critical to Israel's food security, and invest in agriculture to make it more competitive. End production limits.
Break the Rabbinate monopoly on Kashrut through automatic recognition of foreign, recognized certifications.

positions.title: Improving the education system
positions.summary:
Improve quality of public education to meet the level of private schools
Improve teacher salaries, reward outstanding teachers.
Extending the school day until 4:00 PM, and increasing classes, athletics, and provide a hot meal.
Target closing the educational outcomes gap with the OECD average within 5 years.

positions.title: Improving the Education System's Governance
positions.summary:
Completely revamp the Ministry of Education. Dismantle bureaucracy and transfer powers (70% of descisions) to local governments and principals. The Ministry of Education will become a regulator, not an operator.
Set up a "National Education Council" to oversee all 4 streams and create a stable 5-year plan.

positions.title: Combatting incitement
positions.summary: Monitor the education system to make sure that incitement against the state isn't being taught

positions.title: Consitutional Reform
positions.summary:
Create a Constitution in line with the principles of the Declaration of Independence
Term limits for Prime Ministers: Limited to 8 consecutive years

positions.title: Improve the public service
positions.summary: Improve the quality of the public service, through the use of KPIs.

positions.title: Fight corruption though wasteful political spending
positions.summary: "Coalition Funds" (government funding for niche party priorities that is promised to get parties to join a coalition) will be cancelled. Useless government ministries will be closed. Estimated savings: 4.4 billion NIS Move away from political appointments to professional appointments.

positions.title: Judicial Reform
positions.summary: Limiting and formalizing the courts' abilities of Judicial Review and striking basic laws, subject to broad consensus.

positions.title: Creating a core curriculum
positions.summary:
The state will only fund schools in the state education stream, which will be obligated to teach the core curriculum, making up a minimum of 60% of education hours.
Budgets will be focused on student needs, not classroom teaching hours, and will take into account socio-economics so every student succeeds.
Mandatory focus on values and leadership for Grade 12 students.

positions.title: Draft Equality
positions.summary:
National Service Law (ie military service) will apply to all Israeli citizens, regardless of ethnicity, religious community, or gender. Laws that permit draft evasion will be repealed.
Draft dodgers or draft evaders will have benefits removed, specifically:
- Kindergarten subsidies
- Property tax discounts
- Bituach Leumi discounts and student status
- Child support benefits
Estimated savings: 4.4 billion NIS

positions.title: Benefits only to those who embrace Israeli society
positions.summary: Benefits and government funding will only go to citizens and communities that work, enlist, and participate in the state education system.

positions.title: Improve rehabilitation services for injured and disabled veterans
positions.summary:
Create a National Rehabilitation Directorate under the Prime Minister's Office, to complement the activities of the Rehabilitation Division of the Ministry of Defense by creating a coordinating body for the relevant offices in Finance, Health, Housing, and Justice. Provide lawyers at the expense of the state to every injured veteran, from the first meeting. Unblock bureaucracy around rehabilitation, including making all requests and forms digital and streamlined.
Remove roadblocks from injured veterans returning to the workforce without losing support and rights. Give local authorities and communities funding and tools to support disabled veterans. Publish benchmarks and scores to show if the rehabilitation system is improving.

positions.title: Improving mental health access and capacity
positions.summary:
Expand access to mental health supports, by increasing the number of students in mental health fields and incentivising joining the public health services. Also create tools for self care and self support.
Lowering prices for mental health care for youth. Strengthen resilience centers and mental health first aid centers.

positions.title: Housing for disabled veterans
positions.summary: Create a new supportive housing path for wounded and disabled service veterans

positions.title: Housing for veterans
positions.summary: Expand the subsidized rental program by 250,000 units, and build a new city in the Merkaz specifically for young veterans.

positions.title: Improving access to housing
positions.summary: Allow residents in the subsidized rental program to buy their apartment at cost, minus rent paid, after 10 years.

positions.title: Fighting organized crime
positions.summary: Focus on rooting out organized crime. Identify the top 3 families and top 100 criminals and go after them directly

positions.title: Improving Israel's position internationally
positions.summary: Actively combat international anti-Israel sentiment and work to create a positive brand. Improve regional relationships and end international political isolation. Build regional alliances.

positions.title: Move authorities to local governments
positions.summary: Decentralize powers and give more authority to local regional governments

positions.title: Commission of Inquiry
positions.summary: Open a non-partisan, apolitical State Commission of Inquiry into the events of October 7th and the conduct of the state afterwards.

positions.title: Connecting the North with the rest of Israel
positions.summary:
Improve transit services, healthcare services, and transit access in Kiryat Shemona:
- Build a protected emergency room
- Build public transit access
- Provide subsidized flights at 99 shekels to Tel Aviv Ben Gurion

positions.title: Encouraging living in the North
positions.summary:
Encourage return and new settlement though economic benefits:
- No income tax up to 1 million shekels (for 4 years)
- Housing loan of 400,00 shekels for academics and professionals after 7 years of residence

positions.title: Encouraging business in the North
positions.summary:
Create a temporary (4 years) tax exempt zone in the North near Kiryat Shemonah:
- No corporate tax for new local industries, tech companies, and defense companies
- 50% discount on property taxes for businesses
- Grants for expansion
- Subsidize high salaries

positions.title: Building the Periphery
positions.summary: Increase settlement of the Negev and the North, and clamp down on illegal construction

positions.title: Building the North
positions.summary: Define Metula, Shlomi, and Kiryat Shemoneh as a National Reconstruction Area, with the goal of doubling the population (relative to before the war) within 10 years.

positions.title: Fighting crime in the Negev
positions.summary: Recognize that the Negev is in a state of emergency, and bring the Shin Bet to fight crime.

positions.title: Civil Marriage
positions.summary: Break the Rabbanut monopoly on marriage, and facilitate civil marriages

positions.title: Public Transit on Shabbat
positions.summary: Allow public transit on shabbat, based on the decision by the local regional authority.

positions.title: Improve Private and Public Transit
positions.summary: Invest into public transit, increase the amount of high speed rail, and improve bus reliability. Create a national plan to reduce congestion.

positions.title: Get local authorities involved in transit
positions.summary: Move responsibilities and authorities around transit to local regional authorities

positions.title: Improve Miluimnik Benefits
positions.summary:
Active Miluimnikim will get: 
- 1 million shekels towards their first home 
- Free daycare, free after-school programs, free summer school
- 50% discount on all state service fees, including utilities, taxes, and car tests
*Defined as reservists who served 20 days in reserves over 3 years, or 15 days in combat rolls

positions.title: Improve Veteran Benefits
positions.summary:
Veterans (including those who did National Service/Sheirut Leumi) will get:
- Priority in the housing lottery
- Fully funded bachelor's degree (combat veterans will also get a Masters degree)
- Free bus/train pass for 3 years (combat veterans will get for 5 years)
- Fully funded after-school and summer schools
- Daycare for 1000 NIS/month

positions.title: Fighting polygamy
positions.summary: Enforce bans on polygamy, including closing loopholes with the PA, and ensuring that Bituach Leumi isn't providing illegal benefits

positions.title: Supporting the elderly
positions.summary: Increase old age pensions by indexing them to the average salary. Doubling the pensions of retirees making below minimum wage, and gradually increasing pensions for those just above it.

positions.title: Early childhood education
positions.summary:
Move the early childhood education system (0-3 years) to the state education system, and subsidize working and serving parents.
Oversight will strengthen, with childcare requiring certifications and salaries for childcare providers increasing.

positions.title: Give Students an AI Teacher
positions.summary: Create a AI system to act as an individualized private tutor for students, to allow teachers to focus on coaching and providing emotional and social support.

positions.title: Connect schools with science
positions.summary: Establish 15 new STEM centers and create a link between schools, academia, and industry. Give students real world problems and embrace project based learning (PBL).

parties.name: Yisrael Beiteinu
parties.topline: Our government will reconstruct the damaged regions and heal the rifts in Israeli society. It will only contain Zionist parties, and make a modern, democratic, and liberal Jewish state, while also encouraging Aliyah and building ties with the Diaspora.

positions.title: Commission of Inquiry
positions.summary: Establish a full State Commission of Inquiry to examine the failures that lead up to October 7th. The Commission will have a mandate to determine responsibility in the Political, Military, and Intelligence levels. The Commission with be authorized to critique failures and bring justice

positions.title: Draft Equality
positions.summary: Pass a new law that mandates conscription and service of every Israeli at the age of 18, regardless of religion or community. Both military and civilian (healthcare, police, firefighting, ect) will qualify.

positions.title: Benefits only for those who draft
positions.summary:
Anyone who doesn't draft/serve will be barred from rights and benefits, including: 
- Housing and tax discounts
- Childcare benefits
- The right to work in the public service
- Affirmative action to get into university

positions.title: Penalties for draft avoidance
positions.summary:
Draft dodgers will be subject to: 
- Criminal Records
- Losing the right to vote
- Losing the right to leave the country

positions.title: Constitutional Reform
positions.summary:
Create a Constitution, in line with the work prepared by professionals here. Elements include:
  • The largest party in the Knesset gets first chance to form a government
  • Budgets failing will no longer trigger elections
  • Basic laws become constitutional laws
  • Limits to number of ministers
  • Term limits to the Prime Minister
  • The Government has the right to independant legal representation
  • Repealing the "Norwegian Law", where Ministers can opt out of the Knesset and be replaced by other party members
  • Reform the Judicial System
  • Obligate every citizen to serve.

positions.title: Gaza Strip
positions.summary:
Maintain freedom of IDF action in Gaza. 
End Israeli responsibility for Gaza, and stop suppying water, electricity, and maanging the border. 
Transfer responsibility to Egypt, and if Egypt doesn't agree, to the Palestinians to do whatever they want, without out management.

positions.title: West Bank
positions.summary: Work with Jordan to increase security and economic development for Palestinians. Transfer Area A to Jordan, and keep areas B and C.

positions.title: Cost of Living
positions.summary: Reduce regulation, downsize government ministries, increasing competition

positions.title: Core curriculum in Education
positions.summary:
Mandated core curriculum of: Math, English, Technology, Civics, and Tanach. 
Institutions that don't meet requirements will not be funded.

positions.title: Increasing teachers salaries
positions.summary: Salary increases for teachers will be directly deposited to their bank accounts

positions.title: Reducing Rabbanut Overhead
positions.summary: Only one Chief Rabbi of Israel, instead of the current 2. One City Rabbi for each authority. Abolishing religious councils and make religious services be a department in municipalities.

positions.title: Breaking Rabbanut Monopoly on Marriage
positions.summary: Legislate civil marriage and divorce

positions.title: Breaking Rabbanut Monopoly on Conversion
positions.summary: Legislate the Nissim Report on conversion, which would move conversion away from the Rabbanut to an independant (Orthodox) body

positions.title: Public Transit on Shabbat
positions.summary: Allowing local authorities to descide whether to offer public transit on shabbat

positions.title: Aliyah and the Diaspora
positions.summary: Create a committee to encourage Aliyah. Work with the Diaspora to make Aliyah easy and seamless.

positions.title: New Bodies to Fight Crime
positions.summary: Make a National Crime Headquarters against organized crime, and set up 3 new specialized courts for serious crime: The North, Lod, the South

positions.title: New Crime Fighting Legislation
positions.summary: New legislation to allow for the administrative arrest of heads of criminal organizations, and to permit the use of spyware to catch them

positions.title: Palestinian Statehood
positions.summary: No Palestinian State. End the Oslo Accords. Transfer Gaza to Egypt and Area A of the West Bank to Jordan. Do not trust the PA.

positions.title: Israeli-Palestinian and Israeli-Arab Peace
positions.summary:
Regional peace based on:
1. Israeli withdrawal to the Green Line, including leaving 'Arab Jerusalem', which will become the capital of Palestine
2. Israeli withdrawl from the Golan Heights, occupied Syria, and occupied Lebanon
3. A solution to the Palestinian Refugee problem, per UN resolutions
4. Dismantelling settlements in the West Bank

positions.title: Israeli Political Neutrality
positions.summary: Cancellation of the strategic alliance between Israel and the US, and Israeli neutrality

positions.title: Reducing military spending
positions.summary: Reducing military spending, and ending all funding for settlements.

positions.title: Workers rights and conditions
positions.summary:
Protect workers rights and improving working and living conditions. 
Guarenteeing jobs for anyone that wants them. Fighting layoff and unemployment, and ensuring full unemployment benefits.
Fighting descrimination.
Repealing any laws that limit workers rights, the right to assembly, or the right to strike.

positions.title: Guarenteeing Social Services
positions.summary: Guarenteering the right to social services, including free healthcare, housing, and decent living conditions.

positions.title: Funding culture and sports
positions.summary: Increase funding for culture and sports, both infrastructure and development.

positions.title: Equality for Arabs
positions.summary:
Recognize the Arab/Palestinian community as a national minority in the political, cultural, and social spaces.
End discriminatory policies.
Designate Arabic as an official language equivalent to Hebrew

positions.title: Arab housing rights
positions.summary:
End land confiscation and house demolitions. Recognition of all Arab communities. Establish local authorities for those communities. 
Equal allocation of funding between Arab and Jewish local authorities. 
Fund construction in slus and then give them to families in exchange for their old, unlivable apartments.

positions.title: Palestinian Refugees
positions.summary: Give Palestinian refugees Israeli citizenship.

positions.title: Arab economy
positions.summary: Designate Arab towns and communities as development zones. Fund development, housing, education, ect. Encourage building factories in development zones.

positions.title: Crime in Arab communities
positions.summary: Combat sectarian divisions and fighting in Arab communities.

positions.title: Muslim religious organizations
positions.summary: Release funding to Islamic Waqfs, and respect the right of the Arab public to establish their own religious bodies.

positions.title: No draft for the Druze
positions.summary: Abolish mandatory draft for the Druze community

positions.title: Accept Arab academics and scholars
positions.summary: Open the doors of academic institutions to Arab academics

positions.title: Israeli Constitution
positions.summary: Adopt a constitution that protects human and civil rights, defines Israel as a secular country, and ensures equality

positions.title: Protecting liberal rights
positions.summary:
Fight racism and fascism. Protect the freedom of the press, assembly, political activity, concience, and relgious rights.
Recognize the right to refuse to serve in Palestinian territories.
Repeal laws that enable religious coersion

positions.title: Protecting the Knesset
positions.summary: Reject any changes to the proportional electoral system

positions.title: Womens rights
positions.summary:
Repealing discrimanetory laws. Enact a law guarenteeing equal rights for women, based on UN declarations.
Enforce laws against domestic violence, and increase resources for victims of violence.
Increase womens representation in the governement and public institutions

positions.title: Environmental protection
positions.summary: Increase funding for environmental protection and combatting pollution. Protecting water, seas, and rivers. Build sewage treatment plants and plumbing in all towns.

positions.title: Banning weapons of mass destruction
positions.summary: Make weapons of mass descruction illegal. Join the Non-Proliferation Treaty. Make the Middle East a nuclear free zone. Get rid of Israel's nuclear weapons.

parties.name: Religious Zionism
parties.topline: The RZP's goal is to strengthen the state's Jewish Identity, reform the legal system, settle the Negev, Galilee, Judea, and Samaria, preserve religious education, and support immigration, agriculture, and charity.

positions.title: No Platform Published
positions.summary: No updated platform has been published since 2022

parties.name: Otzma Yehudit (Jewish Power)
parties.topline: Complete the land of Israel by annexing Judea and Samaria/West Bank. Strengthening Jewish identity in Education, and reforming the government to strengthen the Jewish character of Israel.

positions.title: No Platform Published
positions.summary: No updated platform has been published since 2022

parties.name: The Democrats
parties.topline: Fight for a strong, secure, and just Israel, which is Jewish and Democratioc, liberal, egalitarian, and in the spirit of the Declaration of Independance.

positions.title: Regional Peace and Normalization with Saudi Arabia
positions.summary:
Recognize that Israel is viewed as an extremist pariah in the region, and rectify it. Build a regional alliance along with the USA and moderate Arab states, to collectively combat radical groups in the area. This group would also work to weaken Iran.
This requires recognizing that we need to make progress with the Palestinians to get regional buy in, and that regional partnerships benefit Israel's security.
The Democrats will also build normalization with Saudi Arabia, and support the India-Middle East-Europe infrastructure system in Israel.

positions.title: End the "Swords of Iron" war on all fronts
positions.summary:
End the war in all areas - Gaza, Syria, and Lebanon, though real agreements and mechanisms that make Israel safer.
Gaza will be demiliterized, Hamas removed, and governance provided by trusted international partners.
The Lebanese army will be strengthened with International forces, Hezbollah will be removed from the border, and Iranian smuggling will be ended. Israeli freedom of response to any violations is non-negotiable.
A security agreement will be made with Syria to stop terrorist groups, stop smuggling to Hezbollah, and make peace on the border.

positions.title: End annexation and fight Jewish terrorism/settler violence
positions.summary:
All annexationist moves on the West Bank will be stopped.
Settler violence against Palestinians will be cracked down on with zero tolerance. Settlements that generate violent actors will be evacuated.
The PA will be strengthened to allow it to crack down on Palestinian terrorism.

positions.title: Try to create a "Palestinian Alternative"
positions.summary: Promote a "moderate, stable, and effective" alternative government for the Palestinians. No terrorist organizations will be allowed to grow into governments.

positions.title: Establish a State Commission of Inquiry into October 7th
positions.summary: Establish a State Commission of Inquiry into the events of October 7th, and fully implement its conclusions.

positions.title: Iran
positions.summary: Every tool will be used to stop Iran from getting a nuclear bomb, and to decrease the missile threat.

positions.title: Strengthen and de-politicize the security establishment
positions.summary:
Strengthen the IDF, Police, Shin Bet, ect. Make sure they have the manpower they need.
Remove politics from the defense sector and make it professional and independent. Make sure appointments are appropriate, and descisions are made by professionals.

positions.title: Increase civil rights in Basic Laws/Constitution
positions.summary:
Add human and social rights (equality, freedom of expression, freedom of protest, freedom of and from religion, healthcare, education, and housing) to the Basic Laws of Israel and give that law 'Supreme Constitutional Status' [editors note: it is unclear if this is a plan for a Constitution]
Amend the Nation State Law to reflect Israel's Jewish and Democratic nature.

positions.title: Define the Knesset's role, powers, and supremacy
positions.summary:
Enact "Basic Law: Legislation" to regulate the status and amendment procedure for Basic Laws, as well as regulate the court's ability for Judicial Review.
Strengthen the Knesset's ability to do its work by changing how committees and the plenum operate. Also strengthen the Ethics Committee, and improve the legislative process.

positions.title: Strengthen Ethics and Professional rules on the Government
positions.summary:
Enact binding ethical rules and standards of service on government ministers and civil service employees.
Formalize legislation around legal advice and the binding status of legal opinions.
Ensure professional appointments procedures for senior appoinments, and protect politically sensitive civil servants from political pressure.
Punish government corruption and misuse of public funds.

positions.title: Term Limits for Prime Ministers
positions.summary:
8 year term limits for Prime Ministers.
Establish systems for impeachement
Prohibit holding government office while under indictment.

positions.title: Judicial Reform
positions.summary:
Repeal legislation designed to weaken the Judicial system, specifically changes to the Judicial Selection Committee and increased powers of the religious courts.
Formalize through legislation the powers and limitations of Judicial Review.
Reform the judicial system by appointing judges, estabilishing more appeal courts, and streamline the judicial process.
Make dispute resolution more accessible through simple processes, community focused solutions, and improving accss to the courts.

positions.title: Life Cycle Events, Kashrut, Conversion
positions.summary:
Break the Rabbinate monopoly on Kashrut. Recognize non-Rabbanut conversion and non-Orthodox conversion.
Recognize liberal streams of Judaism and subsidize them as much as Orthodoxy.
Fund non-orthodox and non-religious burial ceremonies.

positions.title: National Service for All Citizens
positions.summary: Equalize the burden in society by mandating national service for all citizens.

positions.title: Religion in the public square
positions.summary:
Develop 'clear rules' for religious practice in public spaces, ensuring that spaces are are open to all citizens and that religion and prayer services can not be used as a pretext to deny access or discriminate in public spaces. Local authorities will have powers to regulate public spaces, under the restriction of laws that ensure that discrimination is not permitted. They will try to breate a balance between freedom of expression and worship and the right to freedom from religion and accessing public spaces.
Fight the 'religiousization' of the IDF, education system, and public sphere. Stop units and divisions from excluding women in order to integrate Haredim.

positions.title: Public Transit on Shabbat
positions.summary: Public transit will run 7 a week, including on shabbat. Local authorities will be given power to adapt transit lines to appropriately accomodate neighbourhoods and communities.

positions.title: Marriage & Parenthood Rights
positions.summary:
Break the Rabbinate monopoly on marriage and divorce, and legislate full choice in religious or civil marriage. Also work on civil divorce solutions for people who have religious marriages.
Allow same-sex marriage, same-sex parental registration, and surrogacy for same-sex couples. Implement full equality in all government bodies, like the Interior Ministry and Bituach Leumi.

positions.title: Protect the LGBTQ Community
positions.summary:
Prohibit conversion therapy. Recognize, by law, victims of hate crimes. Amend the Criminal Code to include incitement against LGBTQ people and increase punishments for hate crimes based on gender identity.
Add sexual orientation and gender identity to protected characteristics under laws prohibiting discrimination.
End government support for groups that promote discriminating against the LGBTQ community.
Promote a national plan to combat homophobia.
Create up to date procedures for the Trans community in Israeli prisons.

positions.title: Fund initiatives to grow tolerance and support the LGBTQ Community
positions.summary:
Expand budgets for programs that build tolerance and support LGBTQ youth. Add contents on issues facing the community to the education system.
Expant the Division for the Advancement of the LGBT Population in the Ministry of Social Equality.
Fund shelters for youth, and develop programs for youth, seniors, the periphery, in Arab and Haredi society.
Fund culture within the LGBTQ community. Work on training and job placement for people who are discriminated against.

positions.title: Redirect funds from political communities to welfare and economy
positions.summary: Stop funding politically advantagious communities and programs in the West Bank. Instead, use that money for Israel's Social Safety Net and to grow the economy.

positions.title: Support young families and workers
positions.summary: Shorten the work week, add vacation days and sick days. Provide parental leave for fathers. Make early childhood education more accessible and affordable.

positions.title: Lower the cost of living and invest in transit
positions.summary:
Dismantle monopolies and bring in competition. Add more products to the price regulation list.
Lower the cost of public transit and build it out, so that by 2040 Israel is a leading country. Additionally, invest in sidewalks and bike paths, and non-car infrastructure.

positions.title: Address housing costs though urban planning, and environemental protection
positions.summary:
Build more housing, particularly near transit. Expand long term rental and public housing options.
Strengthen the independance and quality of planning institutions, environmental oversight systems, and public participation. Add more local and public representation onto planning committes.
Ensure the participation of environmental organizations on planning committees.
Encourage Urban Renewal over new towns and sprawl.

positions.title: Invest in the Periphery
positions.summary: Invest in the economy, education, health services, housing, culture, and transportation in the North and the South. Move money away from annexation and towards the Periphery.

positions.title: Create a Basic Law: The Environment and Climate
positions.summary:
Protect the environment by creating a Basic Law that will guarentee the right to a healthy environment and require the State to preserve natural resources.
Re-establish the Future Generations Commission [a Knesset committee from the early 2000s that had the right to intervene in legislation that could negatively affect future generations].
Enact a Climate Law, targetting reducing emissions to 50% by 2030 and 100% by 2050.

positions.title: Transition to Clean Industries and Clean Energy
positions.summary:
Close coal power plants. Rehabilitate the Haifa Bay. End industries and factories that are sources of pollution. Increase enforcement against pollution, noise, radiation, and other things that impact public health.
Reduce energy consumption and strengthen energy resilience though a transition to a cleaner and more distributed system. Deploy solar all over the country, and invest in Israeli R&D in energy and climate.

positions.title: Address the garbage crisis
positions.summary:
Reform the waste system by:
  • Establishing a national waste authority
  • Encouraging and investing in recycling and waste reduction to reduce the amount of trash in landfills
  • Making producers responsible for end of life disposal, and for reducing single use packaging materials

Encourage local food production and create a natonal food security plan, and then use that to reduce food waste.

positions.title: Protect plants and animals
positions.summary:
Work with Jordan and the PA to protect the environment and water, and restore the lower Jordan and the Dead Sea.
Fight the illegal trade for plants and animals, and amend Money Laundering and Animal Cruelty laws to address them.
Make 30% of Israeli land and sea into nature preseves by 2030.
Make a national action plan to preserve and restore biodiversity, with funding.
Take more State revenues from natural resource extraction.

positions.title: Even out funding for students between religious streams
positions.summary:
End the current situation where state-religious schools are being funded 26% more than state-hebrew schools and 39% more than state-arab schools.
Funding will based solely on a school's number of students and the socio-economic background.

positions.title: Establish a State Education Council
positions.summary: Establish a council similar to the State-Religious Education Council, for the secular education system.

positions.title: Fund Early Childhood Education
positions.summary: Expand subsidized daycare for ages 0-3 and raise staff salaries

positions.title: End funding for non-state Haredi school systems
positions.summary: Currently, the government funds privately owned school systems in the Haredi community, that do not teach math, english, or civics, and promote draft dodging. That funding will be ended, and invested into the State-Haredi education system.

positions.title: Mandatory Civics Classes
positions.summary:
Add Democracy and Civics to the curriculum at the same status as Math and English.
Add study hours to all streams for Jewish-democratic-liberal identity, at a level currently used in the state-religious stream.
Fund pre-military academies and youth organziations that reflect these values.

positions.title: Invest in Teachers and Principals
positions.summary: Reform the employment structure and strengthen the role of teachers and principals. Decentralize authority to local education boards and increase professional development in staff.

parties.name: Yashar with Gadi Eisenkot
parties.topline:
Israel needs a government that is professional, responsible, and unifying. A government that will lead Israel as a Jewish and Democratic state in the spirit of the Declaration of Independance, with safety and security.
Gadi Eisenkott and Yashar present an alternative with professionalism and integrity.

positions.title: Draft and Service
positions.summary:
Service is mandatory for every citizen, with the explicit goal of integrating the ultra-Orthodox and Arab communities in approproate frameworks. A special process will be made for encouraging and enforcing enlistment in the Haredi community.
The IDF gets priority on manpower, followed by civil and national service. Everyone will need to go through IDF screening.

positions.title: Rule of Law and personal safety
positions.summary:
Restore security to the streets. Combat organized crime, and make a plan to end violence in the Arab community.
Directly fight corruption, organized crime, and protectionism.

positions.title: Rebuild the State for the Jewish People
positions.summary:
Rebuild the state as a Jewish, Democratic, progressive, and just state, in the spirit of the Declaration of Independance. Work to heal the rifts of war and sectarianism.
Work to ensure a Jewish demographic majority for generations, and promote an inclusive and respectful Judaism.
Respect majority decisions, minority rights, human rights, and an independent Judiciary.

positions.title: Establish a State Commission of Inquiry
positions.summary: Establish a State Commission of Inquiry to investigate October 7th, the decade before it, and the conduct of the war.

positions.title: Improve rehabilitation services for impacted citizens
positions.summary: Develop and implement a system for caring for and rehabilitating bereaved families, former hostages, and victims of PTSD.

positions.title: Rehabilitate and invest in the North and the Western Negev
positions.summary: Rehabilitate and strengthen periphery areas impacted by the war.

positions.title: Strengthen the IDF and change the security philosophy
positions.summary: Current security strategies will be replaced with a systematic national strategy, based on planning and preemtive action. The IDF will be strengthened, the borders will be hardened, and Israel will be turned into a regional power.

positions.title: Expand peace agreements
positions.summary: Expand the "circle of peace"

positions.title: Energize the economy
positions.summary: Integrate all sectors into the economy.

positions.title: Lower the cost of living - competition
positions.summary: Dismantle monopolies, strengthen competition, align Israel to international standards to make imports easier.

positions.title: State Benefits for those who contribute
positions.summary:
State benefits (housing benefits, tax credits, ect) will be prioritized for those who serve in the army and for those who work and contribute to the economy.
Housing benefits, tax credits, civil service salaries, scholarships, arnona discounts, grants, Bituach Leumi status, bus pass discounts, after-school funding, ect, will be tiered: 1. Combat veterans, 2. General veterans, 3. National Service alumni

positions.title: Lower the cost of living - infrastructure
positions.summary: Invest in infrastructure, transportation, education, and healthcare in the center and the periphery. Invest in culture.

positions.title: Improve the public service
positions.summary: End political appointments and ensure appointments are made through a professional lens.

positions.title: Constitutional Reform
positions.summary:
Enact Basic Law: Legislation to strengthen the authority and independence of the Knesset.
Term limits for Prime Ministers - 2 terms.
Get rid of useless government ministries.

positions.title: Local government
positions.summary: Expand the independance of local governments to made descisions that match their communities.

positions.title: Stop the brain drain and encourage Aliyah
positions.summary:
Make a strategy to stop Israelis from fleeing the country.
Improve systems of Aliyah and absorbtion with the goal of having 1 million new olim by 2037 and another million by 2048.
Renew the connection between Israel and the Diaspora.

positions.title: Make a planning authority for getting to Israel's Centennial
positions.summary: Make a planning authority to lead the vision and long term plans for all parts of life, and get to 2048 with a prosporous and unified country.

positions.title: Reduce the burden on Reservists
positions.summary:
During times that are neither major war nor peacetime, reserve duties will be capped at 50 days/year, with a hard limit of 150 days in 3 years.
Reservists will be given, under normal circumstances, at least 5 months advanced notice of service times.

positions.title: Benefits for reservists
positions.summary:
Every servicemember will be paid their entitlements automatically, without needing to apply or jump through bureaucratic loops.
The government will invest 20 billion shekels into reservists over 3 years, for the reservists, their families, and their businesses.
During reserve service, soldiers will recieve benefits worth, on average, hundereds of thousands of shekels:
  • Direct benefits
  • Compensation for employers
  • Advanced degree funding
  • Family funding: childcare, babysitting, after school classes, travel.
  • Housing benefits

positions.title: Increased salaries for soldiers
positions.summary: Raise all soldiers salaries by 15%, and combat soldiers salaries by 50% after 3 years of service.

positions.title: Draft Deferment and Exceptions
positions.summary:
A one year deferment of service will be available to a limited pool of individuals who exhibit extraordinary talents in the sports, sciences, arts, and humanities.
Deferment for persuing Torah studies will be available to a maximum of 3% of a years draftees. Selection will be through external criteria and be open to all applicants.
Everyone who defers will be required to complete basic training before their deferral begins

positions.title: Draft dodging
positions.summary:
Draft dodgers will be criminally prosecuted, and will be denied civil and economic benefits:
  • Participation in state tenders
  • Scholarships
  • Housing benefits/Arnona discounts
  • Housing loans and rental assistance
  • Long term rental eligibility
  • Land allocations
  • National Insurance/Bituach Leumi
  • Public Transit discounts
  • Parental benefits
  • Skilled trade training vouchers
  • Business funding
  • Tax discounts
  • Drivers License
  • Right to leave the country
